args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`:
  - `2.675 -> 2.68` (rounds odd digit up)
  - `2.665 -> 2.66` (half goes to even digit)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**

Resolves FIN-212.
